summary: Reviewed all 35 files in the work unit. The repository implements a STARK-based proof system (Ix/Aiur) with a type-checking kernel (IxVM), aggregation circuit (ix_aggr), and Multi-STARK recursive verifier. Files containing formal mathematical content include: Source DSL circuit implementations with assertions/proofs (Aggr/Circuit, Aiur/Library/Blake3/ByteStream/Core, IxVM/Ingress/Kernel/*, MultiStark/*); test files defining Source DSL circuits or Lean theorems (Tests/Aggr, Tests/Aiur/Aiur, Tests/Ix/IxVM, Tests/MultiStark). Files excluded are pure infrastructure: CLI commands (6 files), compiler internals (3), FFI bindings (3), protocol encoding (1), configuration data (2), benchmark orchestration (1), and test orchestration (2). These contain no theorems, lemmas, mathematical definitions, proofs, or circuit implementations — only application logic, data tables, and scaffolding.
